title: dev-autotask.config.json
description: Configuration for one repository used by the dev-autotask workflow. Runtime state and worktrees must remain outside the repository checkout.

path.description: Absolute path to the main checkout. The workflow uses a separate managed worktree for implementation.

remote.description: GitHub owner/repository, used to verify repository and PR identity.

baseBranch.description: Branch from which the task starts and against which its single PR is opened. Runtime validation also checks Git ref syntax.

install.description: Dependency installation command. Inspect it before execution and retain disabled lifecycle scripts unless the task's approved setup requires a scoped exception.

lockfile.description: Repository-relative lockfile used to identify dependency changes.

prepare.description: Non-interactive setup or generation commands required before verification.

verify.description: Nonempty verification commands appropriate to this repository. The task plan adds acceptance checks for the requested behavior.

commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for each install, prepare or verification command. A timed-out command fails even if it exits zero during cleanup.

forbidden.description: Repository-specific hard rules to preserve throughout planning, implementation and review.

worktreeRoot.description: Absolute runtime directory, or a path beginning with ~/. It must resolve outside the main checkout. Each task has separate state and a separate worktree.
